mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 AM, here is today's balanced dish on the weather, featuring clear skies at Verona Community Park and a current temperature of 41 degrees that feels like 34.

The city has announced pavement maintenance for Tuesday and Wednesday involving milling and patching on streets including Nine Mound Road and Mozart Street. Additionally, the Plan Commission is meeting on December 7 to review development projects, including a site plan for Sub-Zero at Liberty Business Park.

Enjoy your weekend with local activities, starting with the Dane County Farmer's Market today. You can also catch live music today at Bailey's Run and Paddy Mac's, plus live music tomorrow at Wisconsin Brewing Company.

In our weekly police report, we noted an incident on October 25 where officers arrested a 40-year-old Verona man for his first offence of O W I after discovering him unresponsive in his vehicle at the intersection of Plympton Street and Rita Avenue.
Make sure to stop by Culver's of Verona today to enjoy the Peanut Butter Fudge Brownie flavor of the day; the store is currently open and will remain so until 11:00 PM.
